prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Chat app with OpenAI API integration
Overview: The project involves developing a cross-platform mobile chat application using React Native that allows pet owners to ask pet-related questions and receive answers from OpenAI API and other veterinarians. The app should be user-friendly and easy to navigate, with features that allow for seamless communication between users and veterinarians. Features: User registration and login system. Ability for users to ask and receive answers to pet-related questions. Integration with OpenAI API to provide automated answers. Feature for veterinarians to register and provide answers to users' questions. In-app messaging system for communication between users and veterinarians. User profile management and settings. Push notification system for new messages and answers. Search functionality for finding previous answers to similar questions. User ratings and feedback system for veterinarians.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a cross-platform mobile chat app in React Native that lets pet owners get quick, helpful answers from OpenAI API and veterinarians in one easy-to-use place.

I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning and NLP developer with 6 years of experience building intelligent application features with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. Your project is a strong fit for my background because it combines conversational AI, search, messaging, and structured user flows—areas where careful implementation makes a big difference in both usability and reliability.

I can help you design and build the AI-assisted question flow so users can ask pet-related questions and receive automated responses from OpenAI API, while still leaving room for veterinarians to register, review, and answer questions directly. I would approach the app with clear separation between user roles, so pet owners, veterinarians, and admin-facing logic remain easy to manage as the product grows.

On the technical side, I can support the backend intelligence needed for smart question handling, similarity search for previous answers, and message-related workflows. I can also help structure the logic for user profiles, settings, ratings, and feedback so the experience stays organized and intuitive. For the AI layer, I’m comfortable working with OpenAI API and NLP-focused tooling, and I can help shape prompts and response handling so the app stays useful and consistent.

I also understand the importance of a smooth mobile experience: registration and login, in-app messaging, push notifications, and easy navigation all need to feel seamless. My goal would be to make the AI and veterinarian support feel like one cohesive chat experience rather than separate systems.

If you’d like, I can help you plan the feature architecture first and then move into implementation in a way that keeps the product scalable and user-friendly from the start.
